name: Tomoe Engineering Co., Ltd.
summary: Tomoe Engineering Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells chemicals, machinery, and equipment in Japan, Asia, and internationally. The company offers plastics, fine chemicals, minerals, and industrial, advanced, and electronic materials for various applications, including packing/conveyance, adhesion, water sealing/waterproofing, industrial materials, electronic materials/device, related parts, coating, grinding, measurement, jigs/tools, painting, and others.
